ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species is the main source of energy for rabbit?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web there is a node labeled "rabbit", with arrows pointing from "flowers" and "grass" to rabbit; the diagram also shows an arrow pointing from rabbit to fox. Reasoning: The arrows indicate energy flowing from the food source to the eater, so in the diagram rabbit's energy sources include flowers and grass. The diagram does not use an obvious mark to distinguish which one is more "main"; combined with common knowledge, rabbits usually mainly feed on grass, so rabbit's main energy source is grass.
